{{Top}}
[[File:HidingAmongEnemies-TCGNA.png|thumb|right|300px|The ''Millennium Falcon'' using its [[landing claw]] to hide on a conning tower.]]
A '''conning tower''' was a raised platform on a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] from which an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] could control the vessel.

[[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] had conning towers that protruded from the superstructure. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] spared a single glance out of the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor''{{'s}}]] [[Viewport/Legends|observation ports]] to confirm his suspicions that the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] had berthed itself on the conning tower of the nearby Star Destroyer [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']].<ref name="GG3">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref>
